Goal: Detect keypad text, numbers, symbols, and small printed shapes.
Notes: Primary benchmark for Threshold -> Morphology -> Contour and AI Recipe validation.

Goal: Detect text, numbers, symbols, and faint low-contrast controls in one branched recipe.
Notes: LLM recipe benchmark with text/symbol and low-contrast ROI branches. Final OverlayMerge produces one review image that combines all branch detections.

Goal: Verify general binary/morphology/contour behavior on the keypad sample.
Notes: Broad contour baseline; expected to produce metrics and overlays.

Goal: Measure overall brightness of the keypad sample with the Mean tool.
Notes: Basic measurement benchmark: confirms Mean tool metrics, result image metadata, and acceptance messages are available through the same recipe path. Threshold preprocessing is explicitly disabled so the metric reflects source brightness.

Goal: Resize the keypad sample to 50 percent using RotateScale.
Notes: Basic transform benchmark: confirms RotateScale output dimensions and image metadata are preserved through the recipe runner.

Goal: Detect many small rice-like particles as independent contours.
Notes: Particle-count benchmark tuned away from the old broad contour result.

Goal: Detect many small rice-like particles through Blob after binary cleanup.
Notes: Blob benchmark for repeated object count, Blob result metrics, overlays, and external runner parity.

Goal: Verify that normal particle density produces many small blob candidates.
Notes: Good reference for Blob density classification. Same Blob pipeline should produce a high count of small particles.

Goal: Verify that sparse non-rice particles produce a much lower blob count with smaller average area.
Notes: Controlled NG reference for Blob density classification. The same Blob pipeline still produces result metrics, then rejects sparse density through the ResultCount acceptance gate.

Goal: Detect repeated small pin features as contours.
Notes: Pin feature benchmark for repeated object count and future missing/bent checks.

Goal: Detect large bent-pin regions as a first contour-based defect baseline.
Notes: Early defect benchmark; future work should add line/angle or edge-based checks.

Goal: Detect upper and lower bent-pin defect regions through separate ROI branches and return one merged review image.
Notes: Stronger defect benchmark: ROI branch contours must each find one large region, then OverlayMerge must publish one final review layer.

Goal: Detect individual upper pin shafts on a normal pin image and verify no shaft is abnormally wide.
Notes: OK reference for bent-pin classification. ResultCount must remain 13 and maximum shaft width should stay within the normal range in both px and mm.

Goal: Detect individual upper pin shafts on a bent-pin image and verify the bent shaft becomes abnormally wide.
Notes: Controlled NG reference for bent-pin classification. ResultCount must remain 13, then the same Contour pipeline rejects the sample through the BoundsWidthMax acceptance gate when one shaft becomes too wide.

Goal: Detect die-pad surface regions on image 1.
Notes: Die-pad contour benchmark; future work should add ROI and pad-shape checks.

Goal: Detect die-pad surface regions on image 2.
Notes: Die-pad contour benchmark; future work should add ROI and pad-shape checks.

Goal: Detect die-pad surface regions on image 3.
Notes: Die-pad contour benchmark; future work should add ROI and pad-shape checks.

Goal: Detect die-pad surface regions on image 4.
Notes: Die-pad contour benchmark; future work should add ROI and pad-shape checks.

Goal: Fit a straight pin rail edge with Filter -> EdgeDetection -> LineGauge.
Notes: Legacy Required LineGauge benchmark aligned with the current straight-rail acceptance gate. The tilted Pins.bmp case is covered by LineGauge_PinsTilted_Bad.

Goal: Verify that a straight pin rail stays near zero degree while keeping enough edge points.
Notes: Good reference for LineGauge angle classification. Same line recipe should fit a long near-horizontal rail.

Goal: Verify that a tilted pin rail produces a clearly higher fitted line angle.
Notes: Bad reference for LineGauge angle classification. Same line recipe should reject angular drift through the LineAngleAvg acceptance gate.

Goal: Match the 7PQRS keypad button with a cropped template.
Notes: Regression benchmark for Matching template loading, template preservation, score metrics, and overlays.

Goal: Verify that the 7PQRS template is rejected on an image without the target.
Notes: Expected-failure reference for template target presence. MatchingNoResult is the correct behavior; if this passes, tighten score threshold, ROI, or template crop.

Goal: Verify that the 7PQRS template is rejected on an unrelated board image.
Notes: Expected-failure reference for template wrong-target behavior. MatchingNoResult is correct; if this passes, tighten score threshold, ROI, or template crop.

Goal: Verify that the 7PQRS template is rejected on an unrelated switch image.
Notes: Expected-failure reference for template no-target behavior. MatchingNoResult is correct; if this passes, tighten score threshold, ROI, or template crop.

Category: Edge based template matching / OK reference
Goal: Match an asymmetric L fiducial by gradient direction instead of raw image intensity.
Notes: Good reference for edge based template matching. The target keeps the same edge geometry while the background has grid and distractor edges.

Category: Edge based template matching / NG reference
Goal: Verify that similar but geometrically different edges are rejected by the edge template.
Notes: Expected-failure reference for edge based target presence. If this passes, raise SCORE_MIN, reduce SEARCH_STEP, or improve template uniqueness.

Goal: Match a feature-rich template and verify template/crop/overlay review behavior.
Notes: Good reference for FeatureMatching score discrimination. The correct target should keep a high ScoreMax and a stable detected crop.

Goal: Verify that an unrelated switch image stays far below the feature-template score gate.
Notes: Bad reference for FeatureMatching score discrimination. The matcher may still return one geometric hypothesis, so the shared pipeline must reject it through the ScoreMax acceptance gate.

Goal: Verify that an unrelated board image stays far below the feature-template score gate.
Notes: Bad reference for FeatureMatching wrong-target behavior. A low ScoreMax with a tiny crop means the shared pipeline must reject it through the ScoreMax acceptance gate.

Goal: Verify that a bright grayscale reference stays inside the normal brightness range.
Notes: Good reference for Mean brightness drift classification. Threshold preprocessing is disabled so the metric reflects source brightness.

Goal: Verify that a dim grayscale reference produces a much lower mean brightness.
Notes: Bad reference for Mean brightness drift classification. Same Mean pipeline should expose controlled NG through MeanValueAvg below the normal brightness acceptance range.

Goal: Detect dark printed dot-matrix text on a reflective background.
Notes: Representative recursive EasyImage text sample using the Threshold -> Morphology -> Contour baseline.

Goal: Fit a straight pin rail edge from the EasyGauge sample folder.
Notes: Representative recursive EasyGauge sample aligned with the current LineAngleAvg acceptance gate. The tilted Pins.bmp case is covered by LineGauge_PinsTilted_Bad.

Goal: Measure the gap between adjacent vertical pin edges with LineDistance.
Notes: Distance benchmark for pin spacing. This checks paired red measurement lines between two vertical edges, not fitted LineGauge line length.

Goal: Detect large bent-pin regions from the EasyGauge sample folder.
Notes: Representative recursive EasyGauge defect sample using the same geometry gate as the required BentPin baseline.

Goal: Detect die-pad surface regions from EasyMatch image 1.
Notes: Representative recursive EasyMatch die-pad sample using the same contour geometry gate as the required DiePad baseline.

Goal: Detect die-pad surface regions from EasyMatch image 2.
Notes: Representative recursive EasyMatch die-pad sample using the same contour geometry gate as the required DiePad baseline.

Goal: Detect die-pad surface regions from EasyMatch image 3.
Notes: Representative recursive EasyMatch die-pad sample using the same contour geometry gate as the required DiePad baseline.

Goal: Detect die-pad surface regions from EasyMatch image 4.
Notes: Representative recursive EasyMatch die-pad sample using the same contour geometry gate as the required DiePad baseline.

Goal: Detect many small rice-like particles from the EasyObject sample folder.
Notes: Representative recursive EasyObject particle sample using the same particle-count contract as Rice_Particle.

Goal: Verify that the OK film image only produces small background candidates in dark-spot ROIs.
Notes: Good reference for film dark-spot classification. It should produce only small background candidates in the monitored ROIs.

Goal: Verify that the bad film image produces larger dark-spot candidates in the monitored ROIs.
Notes: Controlled NG reference for film dark-spot classification. The same Contour pipeline still produces candidates, then rejects the sample through the AreaMax acceptance gate when a dark spot is larger than the OK reference.

Goal: Verify that the normal surface image keeps edge-contour candidates near the background level.
Notes: Good reference for surface-defect classification. The same edge-contour recipe should produce only a few small background candidates on a normal surface.

Goal: Detect low-contrast surface-defect edge candidates without selecting the whole surface.
Notes: Required surface-defect benchmark using Filter -> EdgeDetection -> Morphology -> Contour. This guards against whole-surface false positives.

Goal: Detect low-contrast surface-defect edge candidates without selecting the whole surface.
Notes: Bad reference for surface-defect classification. The same edge-contour recipe should expose many more candidates and a larger defect edge region than the normal reference.

Goal: Verify generic threshold and contour behavior on a color-dot sample.
Notes: Representative EasyColor sample. This is a grayscale contour smoke, not a color-classification contract.

Goal: Verify generic threshold and contour behavior on a clear fiducial sample.
Notes: Good reference for fiducial visibility. The same generic contour recipe should find many separated candidates without a broad merged hidden-region contour.

Goal: Verify that a hidden fiducial produces fewer candidates and a broad merged contour.
Notes: Bad reference for fiducial visibility. The same recipe should expose the hidden condition through lower ResultCount and larger BoundsWidthMax.

Goal: Verify that the clear fiducial keeps enough separated contour candidates for blur comparison.
Notes: Good reference for fiducial blur classification. Clear image should keep high candidate count and normal maximum contour width.

Goal: Verify that a blurred fiducial reduces separated candidates while keeping the same generic contour pipeline runnable.
Notes: Bad reference for fiducial blur classification. Blur should collapse details into fewer candidates and a larger dominant area.

Goal: Verify that the clear fiducial keeps enough separated contour candidates for ink-contamination comparison.
Notes: Good reference for fiducial ink classification. Clear image should remain high-count without contamination collapse.

Goal: Verify that an ink-marked fiducial produces fewer contour candidates and a lower dominant area than the clear reference.
Notes: Bad reference for fiducial ink classification. Ink contamination should reduce candidate count and keep the dominant contour in the ink-marked range.

Goal: Verify that the clear fiducial keeps enough separated contour candidates for solder-contamination comparison.
Notes: Good reference for fiducial solder classification. Clear image should remain high-count with normal maximum contour width.

Goal: Verify that a solder-marked fiducial produces fewer candidates and a wider merged contour.
Notes: Bad reference for fiducial solder classification. Solder contamination should reduce candidate count while creating a wider merged contour.

Goal: Verify generic threshold and contour behavior on a barcode sample.
Notes: Representative EasyBarCode sample. This does not validate barcode decoding yet.

Goal: Verify generic threshold and contour behavior on a QR-code sample.
Notes: Representative EasyQRCode sample. This does not validate QR decoding yet.

Goal: Verify generic threshold and contour behavior on an OCR character sample.
Notes: Representative EasyOcr sample. This does not validate OCR recognition yet.

Goal: Verify generic threshold and contour behavior on a matrix-code sample without validating decoding.
Notes: Representative EasyMatrixCode sample. This is a generic contour smoke, not DataMatrix decoding.

Goal: Verify generic threshold and contour behavior on an OCR2 character sample without validating text recognition.
Notes: Representative EasyOCR2 sample. This is a generic contour smoke, not OCR recognition.

Notes: Do not run as an input sample by default.
